description: Fork of exp163 (per-head MLP Q/K + SDPA, val_bpb≈1.81 @ step 5200). Widen MLP hidden 256→1024 (4x). Per-head MLP: Linear(64,1024) → ReLU → Linear(1024,64) → LayerNorm(64). Q/K params per layer grow from 0.4M to 1.6M; total 6 layers Q/K from 2.4M to 9.5M. Total budget ~175M (was 168M for exp163, 392M for exp154). Tests whether wider MLP closes more of the gap to exp154's LUT.
